summary.en-US: Fill CUIMS login details, solve the CAPTCHA on-device, skip promotional interstitials, and hide event or feedback interruptions.

version.approval_notes: CUIMS Clear is an independent student utility. It stores credentials only in Firefox storage.local and makes no network requests of its own. CAPTCHA images are processed on-device by a bundled copy of Tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), its WASM core, and the @tesseract.js-data English model; no data leaves the browser and no remote code is loaded at runtime. The minified vendor files are published upstream builds from the tesseract.js npm package (tesseract.js, tesseract.js-core); unminified sources are available at https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and licenses are included in vendor/. All other source files are unminified and included directly in the package.
